# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/pinned

List a repository's pinned pull requests

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-380`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — []*api.PullRequest

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Pull request ID |
| `number` | int64 | PR index |
| `title` | string | PR title |

- **404** — Repository not found
- **500** — Database error loading PR attributes
